No—not across all sensors for the full period. NASA FIRMS reported **zero thermal detections intersecting the property** during the covered days from October 13 to November 12, 2026. However, VIIRS S-NPP data were unavailable from November 2 to November 6. MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 covered the full period.

No detections also do not prove that no fire occurred; small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected.
